description: This file defines a final class `ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder` that implements the `JsonObjectBuilder` interface for constructing immutable JSON objects. It provides methods to set, remove, and build JSON objects with support for nested fields, predicates, and various data types.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating immutable JSON objects, supporting various data types, nested structures, and prevention of duplicate keys.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the builder.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JSON field with a value of a specific primitive type, where the key is a CharSequence.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JSON field with a JsonValue.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JSON field with a value defined by a field definition object.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a JSON field by key or by field definition.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON fields to the builder, optionally filtered by a predicate.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable JsonObject based on the current fields.
